prompt: Audit this ASP.NET Core auth setup after a .NET 10 upgrade. Check cookies, OIDC, passkeys, CORS, and whether the current config has security regressions.
assertions: The response covers cookies, OIDC, passkeys, and CORS as distinct review areas.
The response mentions that built-in .NET 10 passkeys are scoped and have limitations, including primary-factor behavior.
The response frames the task as a security and upgrade audit rather than a blind rewrite.
